column1: # Engine composes per account-creation-era style; collisions get digit suffixes.
# Styles: dialup (2001-2003, lowercase, 1-2 short words) · xx_era (2004-2008,
# xX{core}Xx / {core}{digits}, leet swaps at low rate) · underscore (2009-2012,
# firstname_year style (~28%, all eras) is built by the ENGINE from
# customers.first_name + birth/signup year — no bank needed (anomaly A5).
